about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for ad7 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The closing note and the page footnote are joined onto item (b), so the footnote reads as part of the transition rule instead of a footnote to 'England*'.
findings.evidence: tree: "(b) is started within the period of two months beginning on that day. Please note that ... * This approved document gives guidance"

findings.problem: The 'Materials' heading is placed under the 'Regulation' box heading instead of beside 'Regulation 7 of the Building Regulations' as its own amendment heading.
The boxed regulation text is kept as a one-cell table; the words are complete but the regulation is typed as a table rather than text.
findings.evidence: tree: columns ["Regulation"], grid one cell "Materials and workmanship 7. (1) Building work shall be carried out—"

findings.problem: The intro heading is split in two at the column break, so 'document:' becomes a separate heading and the right-column terms sit under it.
findings.evidence: source: "The following are key terms used in this document:" / tree: "The following are key terms used in this" > "document:"

findings.problem: Each key term and its definition are run together into one block of text with no separation between terms.
findings.evidence: tree: "...www.bsigroup.co.uk Building control body A local authority or an approved inspector. CEN The Comité..."
